source_figure: Fig S1B (synthesis scheme); Fig 3A / Fig 5A (one arm)
note: The ionizable lipid is NEVER drawn as a complete structure. It is branched PEI Mn~600 (1 eq) ring-opened with 14 eq of a C15 1,2-epoxide, i.e. a polydisperse statistically substituted polymer: no single SMILES is correct, so the anchor is deliberately EMPTY and the gap is visible.

Et2N-CH2-CH(OH)-C13H27, the arm as drawn, with the PEI backbone nitrogen replaced by the drawing's diethylamino group. Built by atom-mapped attachment so the regiochemistry is pinned: the Markovnikov isomer has the identical formula and exact mass.

CONNECTIVITY ONLY. Re-traversed from the drawn structure starting at the C3 hydroxyl. The hand-written stereo attempt gave HVYWMOMLDIMFJA-OXMOYTRBSA-N, a diastereomer with 4 of 8 centres inverted, identical in formula, exact mass and skeleton block; it was discarded rather than tuned against the registry.
Built by fragment assembly from sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine and two stearoyl fragments through atom-mapped attachment; no atom deleted.
